ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton AT-US-005-01: the PR fast lane runs install, lint/format, typecheck, unit and build in the documented order on ubuntu-24.04 with Node from .node-version; the security scans run in the parallel, isolated scans job that ci-gate needs (coverage and contract-drift steps join in TASK-015)
ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton AT-US-005-01 / PR10-SEC-02: licences, registry signatures and the advisory audit run right after the install, before deps:rebuild and any head code
ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton PR10-SEC-02: the scans job runs no npm, nothing from node_modules or the workspace, and takes a literal Node version without cache
ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton PR10-SEC-01 / review M2: gitleaks mounts only .git, ignores inline allow markers, diffs merges against the first parent and has no network
ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton PR10-SEC-03 / review m3: Semgrep takes its rules, .semgrepignore and .gitignore from the base ref
ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton PR10-SEC-04: the record check binds to the PR number on pull requests and is not evaluated on push

ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton review m3 / m2 / D-ORCH-018: the base-ref lint fixture step takes the suite, harness (lint-fixtures.mjs, fixture-expectations.mjs, tools/test-support) and Jest config from the base and runs exactly that suite under that config in no-weakening mode; the classifier treats jest.config.ts and tools/test-support as lint controls
ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton AT-US-005-01: integration, images and e2e jobs are not scheduled for pull requests (D-ORCH-001)

ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton AT-US-005-02 (lane A part): push to main re-runs only lane A behind CI_MAIN_FAST_LANE, skipping docs-only pushes; ci.yml has no schedule; the full stages run in lane C on workflow_dispatch (TASK-015)
ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton review m5 (b): pull-request runs share a per-PR group and cancel superseded runs; every push to main gets its own group, so none is cancelled

ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton AT-US-005-03: any failing stage fails the run: no continue-on-error, no always()/failure() steps, a failing unit test skips build; ci-gate runs unless cancelled and fails unless both lanes succeeded (a skipped lane is not green)

ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton AT-US-005-04 (lane A part): a pull request run pushes no image; the policy allows image pushes only in an `images` job gated on dispatch/main/tags (lane C images job: TASK-015)
ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton AT-US-005-05: ci.yml has no terraform apply and no job that assumes an AWS role (deploy/canary jobs belong to cd.yml, which no lane A trigger runs)

ci-policy: US-005 CI pipeline skeleton AT-US-005-06 (static part): integration is not scheduled in lane A; the Jest integration project runs *.int.test.ts with Testcontainers PostgreSQL and Redis-compatible modules (hosted run: lane C, TASK-015; JUnit evidence under docs/05-quality: lane B, TASK-011)

ci-policy: supply chain (SEC-TC-32, SEC-TC-45, SEC-TC-64 CI parts) SEC-TC-32: read-only token, no pull_request_target, actions pinned by SHA, every install --ignore-scripts, npm audit signatures with the scope override
ci-policy: supply chain (SEC-TC-32, SEC-TC-45, SEC-TC-64 CI parts) SEC-TC-45 (CI part): scripts are off at workflow and job level; lockfile provenance and the 7-day cooldown run before the install
ci-policy: supply chain (SEC-TC-32, SEC-TC-45, SEC-TC-64 CI parts) SEC-TC-64 (CI part): gate tooling runs from the base ref when the base has it; tools run as `npm exec --no --`, never npx

ci-policy: supply chain (SEC-TC-32, SEC-TC-45, SEC-TC-64 CI parts) SEC-TC-48 (CI part, TASK-011): lane B evidence is verified by the base-ref tools/quality after npm ci and before any head code; the head copy only reports (bootstrap)

ci-policy: supply chain (SEC-TC-32, SEC-TC-45, SEC-TC-64 CI parts) SEC-TC-48 (CI part, PR #23 R1-m2): `--report-only` occurs exactly once in the lane B step, at the end of the bootstrap head-copy line; the base-ref line is pinned in full (mutation-proof)
